newsitem.title: USA: Sun City faces possible AMEX delisting.
newsitem.headline: Sun City faces possible AMEX delisting.

text.p: Sun City Industries Inc said Thursday it no longer satisfies the guidelines for continued listing on the American Stock Exchange.
Sun City also said it expected to issue an announcement in the coming days regarding its previously disclosed merger talks.

"At this time, there can be no assurance that the company will remain listed," Sun City said, reiterating a warning issued on May 29. The earlier statement also noted Sun City's "ability to continue as a going concern was in question."
The company also said merger talks with privately-owned SeaSpecialities Inc of Miami, first announced May 30, were still underway.
"The merger discussions are still ongoing; we expect to make an announcement the next day or so," said Malvin Avchen, the company's chief executive.
Sun City today reported a net loss per share of $0.04 for the first quarter ended May 3, compared with a $0.08 profit the year before.
The company's shares opened today at 1-1/2, down 1/8.
